regions.name: National
regions.where: All of Nicaragua (no regional titles or locator map)

harvest.name: Apante harvest (third season; no shaded rainy season for it)

planting.name: Apante planting (third season; after the shaded rains end)

regions.notes: Rains: mid-May to mid-Jul and mid-Aug to mid-Nov. Lean box mid-Apr to mid-Aug. Harvests: Primera mid-Aug to mid-Sep; Postrera (spelt 'Postera' on the image) mid-Nov to end-Dec; Apante Mar to mid-Apr. Planting: Primera May to mid-Jun; Postrera Sep to mid-Oct; Apante mid-Nov to end-Dec. Apante weeding wraps into Jan.

assign.method: Single national calendar with no regional titles or locator map; every adm1 mapped to national.

transcriber_notes: Edges drawn at mid-month are counted (at-least-half rule); many Nicaraguan edges sit exactly at mid-month (rains, lean box, Primera harvest both ends, Postrera/Apante harvest and planting starts). Apante is linked to no rainy season because it is planted after the Second Rainy Season shading ends.
